graphs.title: The volume rises in a straight line with the amount of gas.
graphs.label: Volume at room conditions

sentences: Set the amount to 2 mol and compare the two volumes.
title: The volume of a gas from its amount
goal: Compare the volume of the same amount of gas at room conditions and at standard temperature and pressure.
note: One mole of any gas has the same volume under the same conditions. At room conditions the molar volume is 24 dm3/mol and at STP it is 22.4 dm3/mol. The volume is the amount in moles times the molar volume.
hints: Write the formula: volume = amount x molar volume.
Choose the molar volume for the conditions.
Multiply the amount in moles by the molar volume.
worked_solution: Write the formula: volume = amount x molar volume.
Multiply by the amount in moles to get the volume in dm3.
